info.title: IntentGuard agent spending API
info.description: Owner-approved testnet vaults: native X Layer USDC with permitted CCTP V2 payments on Base Sepolia/Arbitrum Sepolia; legacy TEST-USDT agents are preserved. TapeOut and finalized GenLayer approval precede source burn. Only PAID confirms destination delivery. USDT0 remains unsupported on testnet.

parameters.description: Reuse for identical payment details; conflicting content returns HTTP 409.

post.description: Admit one credential-bound payment with a stable Idempotency-Key. Destination defaults to source; unsupported/unapproved destinations are rejected before admission. Cross-chain source burns occur only after guard plus finalized review. HTTP202,APPROVED,burn,attestation or submitted mint do not mean delivery.

MerchantAdmin.description: Testnet merchant administration credential; never an agent key.

totalBudget.description: Exact six-decimal positive token amount within uint64 atomic units; never a JSON number.

perPaymentLimit.description: Exact six-decimal positive token amount within uint64 atomic units; never a JSON number.

periodBudget.description: Exact six-decimal positive token amount within uint64 atomic units; never a JSON number.

amount.description: Exact six-decimal positive token amount within uint64 atomic units; never a JSON number.

destinationChainId.description: Optional spending EVM chain ID; defaults to this card's source chain. The owner must have approved it. Supported native USDC targets1952,84532,421614; never CCTP domain IDs.

funded.description: Current actual source-vault token balance; decreases on direct payment, burn or withdrawal. Not cumulative deposits.

spent.description: Lifetime amount paid directly or burned through CCTP. Bridge burn consumes budget before merchant delivery.

reserved.description: Lifetime amount currently reserved by pending requests.

available.description: Physical token balance minus pending reservations; independent of remaining budget capacity.

periodSpent.description: Paid or burned amount attributed to the original reservation period when it is the current period.

periodReserved.description: Pending amount reserved in the current budget period.

paymentSymbol.description: Actual card asset: USDC for native CCTP cards, TEST-USDT for existing testnet vaults.

paymentTxHash.description: Confirmed recipient delivery transaction: source chain for direct payments, destination chain for CCTP. Do not open a Base/Arbitrum hash on X Layer.

activation.description: Exact verified factory input. CCTP_V2 activation supplies selected domains37(source),6(Base),3(Arbitrum). Missing kind preserves legacy factory activation.

token.description: Legacy configured token. Obtain each agent's actual token from /me or CardView; do not use this global token to fund a USDC card.

paymentSymbol.description: Legacy global token label. Agent and transaction paymentSymbol identify their actual asset.

cctpFactoryAddress.description: Native USDC card factory; null means activation unavailable, even when issuer routes are verified.

paymentSymbol.description: Actual card asset: USDC for native CCTP cards, TEST-USDT for existing testnet vaults.

paymentTxHash.description: Confirmed recipient delivery transaction: source chain for direct payments, destination chain for CCTP. Do not open a Base/Arbitrum hash on X Layer.

AgentUsage.description: Actual admitted operations. activeCount includes bridge reconciliation. fundsMoved sums PAID delivery only across allowed testnets in the same issuer asset; a burn is excluded until delivery.

fundsMoved.description: Exact sum of this agent's PAID amounts in its immutable token. Pending burns are excluded.

chainId.description: Source vault chain. Delivery may occur on allowed destination chains; inspect the individual bridge record.

destinationChainIds.description: Owner-approved spending testnets. Canonical commitment sorts these IDs. Chain1952 must be included to allow direct source-chain payments.

amount.description: Exact six-decimal positive token amount within uint64 atomic units; never a JSON number.

BridgeView.description: Actual persisted CCTP progress; absent before a verified burn. A burn/attestation/mint submission is not PAID; destination receipt and source acknowledgement must be verified. Never initiate a second burn during recovery.
